# Aunt Jamesina

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Jimsie  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P47](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0047), [v3 ch.Interlude P41](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0041), [v3 ch.Charming P1](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0001), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P0](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** queen of housemothers  <sub>[v3 ch.Opens P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)</sub>
- **Family:** [Elizabeth](../character/elizabeth.md) (child)

## Appearance

Aunt Jamesina is a tiny old woman with snow-white hair styled in quaint little puffs over her ears. She has a small, softly-triangular face with pink cheeks and large, soft blue eyes filled with an unquenchable, youthful brightness.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)_

## Personality

Aunt Jamesina is a sweet, mirthful, and old-fashioned woman whose attire and personal opinions reflect her traditional nature. Though she hates visiting and holds a low opinion of [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), she remains loving toward her, and she maintains a proper respect for the clergy. Despite harboring a deep horror of snakes, she traveled to India to explore her daughter's mission field.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Speaks P10](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0010), [v3 ch.Jonas P5](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0005), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P42](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0042), +1 more_

## History

Aunt Jamesina came to live at Patty's Place to act as housekeeper for [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) during their college years. She brought her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat, and quickly established a comfortable, cheerful household routine with the girls, freely sharing her relaxed views on chaperoning and stories about her past suitors. Throughout their time together, she provided a warm domestic presence, chatting with the young women about their studies, romantic entanglements, and visitors, while witnessing major events such as [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's engagement and Anne's suitors. Following the end of their college years and the group's departure from Patty's Place, Aunt Jamesina traveled to India to explore her daughter's mission field, overcoming her personal horror of snakes to do so.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P3](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0003), [v3 ch.Friend P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 ch.Friend P15](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0015), [v3 ch.Friend P16](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0016), [v3 ch.Friend P17](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0017), +333 more_

## Quotes

> "She couldn’t take Joseph with her so she begged me to take him. I really couldn’t refuse. He’s a beautiful cat—that is, his disposition is beautiful. She called him Joseph because his coat is of many colors."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056)

> "Kittens have to be drowned, I admit, or the world would be overrun. But no decent, grown-up cat should be done to death—unless he sucks eggs."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Relationships P69](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0069)

> "Well, I hope so, Anne. I do hope so, because I love her. But I can’t understand her—she beats me. She isn’t like any of the girls I ever knew, or any of the girls I was myself."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040)

> "Yes, in my soul. But I’ll admit my legs aren’t as young as yours. You go and get some fresh air, Anne. You look pale lately."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Charming P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004)

> "Anybody is liable to rheumatism in her legs, Anne. It’s only old people who should have rheumatism in their souls, though. Thank goodness, I never have. When you get rheumatism in your soul you might as well go and pick out your coffin."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Charming P10](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0010)

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-jamesina--phil-gordon.md)

[Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) lives with Aunt Jamesina at Patty's Place, where they share a loving, cozy domestic life. The two spend their time chatting comfortably alongside the other housemates about household routines, local news, and suitors. Aunt Jamesina holds a deep affection for [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), fondly reflecting with [Anne](../character/anne.md) on Phil's whimsical personality and her various romantic prospects.

- Friend of — loves and lives with her  <sub>[v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040)</sub>
